title: Threshold sign of a signed sum
statement: Let $k,m$ be natural numbers, and let $y$ assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each of the $m$ coordinates. The threshold sign of the sum of these signs minus $k$ is $1$ if and only if the sum of their integer values is strictly greater than $k-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns a sign to each of the $m$ coordinates
